Destination.description:
Where a call would go: its host and port, and every address the host resolved to.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the host is empty.

addresses.description: Every address the host resolved to, each checked.
addresses.title: Addresses

host.description: The host asked for, a name or an address.
host.title: Host

private_data.description:
Whether the caller built the URL's path or query from private data, which a tainted
caller may never send.
private_data.title: Private Data

Destination.title: Destination

InternalUpstream.description:
A private destination the operator declares for a purpose, such as a self-hosted forge.

It is reached only under its purpose, on its port, and only where every address its host
resolves to is inside its range, still pinned against rebinding and narrowed by taint.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the host isn't a lowercase name, or is a metadata endpoint's, or the
        range holds a metadata endpoint's address.

network.description: The range its host must resolve into, such as ``10.0.4.0/24``.
network.title: Network

InternalUpstream.title: InternalUpstream

Purpose.description:
Why something calls out, and where the operator lets it reach.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the key isn't of :data:`PURPOSE`'s form, a host pattern isn't a host or
        ``*.`` and one, or two internal destinations share a host and port.

hosts.description:
The hosts it may reach, the operator's universe for it, which tenants and workspaces only
narrow: names, or ``*.`` and a name for any name below it.
hosts.title: Hosts

internal.description: The private destinations the operator declares for it.
internal.title: Internal

Purpose.title: Purpose

Verdict.description:
Whether a call may go out, and to which checked address.

Raises:
    ValueError: Unless an allowed verdict has an address and a refused one has none.

address.description: The checked address to connect to, and only it, if allowed.
address.title: Address

allowed.description: Whether the call may go out.
allowed.title: Allowed

internal.description: Whether it is one of the purpose's internal destinations.
internal.title: Internal

reason.description: Why, for the log and the caller: never the request's body or headers.
reason.title: Reason

Verdict.title: Verdict

description: lattice's egress contract: `purpose` is why something calls out and where the operator lets it, `destination` where a call would go, resolved, and `verdict` whether it may, and to which checked address.
